name: Vinnie 'The Pawn' Kowalski
flavor_text: A loudmouth from Brooklyn who learned chess last Tuesday. Hits hard but thinks harder... wait, no, he doesn't think at all.

name: Suki 'The Knight' Tanaka
flavor_text: Moves like an L-shaped nightmare. You never see her coming — but you always feel her leaving.

gimmick.name: L-Shaped
gimmick.description: Her combos alternate attack and movement (attack+dodge or dodge+attack). Predictable but deadly.

name: Elena 'The Bishop' Petrov
flavor_text: Former chess prodigy turned amateur boxer. Reads your patterns like an open book. Good luck.

gimmick.name: Diagonal Thinking
gimmick.description: Gains +2 damage every round regardless of chess performance. Outpace her or get overwhelmed.

name: Marcus 'The Rook' Williams
flavor_text: Built like a castle wall. You can hit him all day and he'll still be standing. Patient. Inevitable.

gimmick.name: Fortress
gimmick.description: Cannot be KO'd by a single hit (min 1 HP). Blocking heals him for 2 HP. Wear him down with combos.

name: Magnus 'The Grandmaster' Thunderfist
flavor_text: The reigning champion. They say he solved a mate-in-7 while getting punched in the face. He didn't flinch.

gimmick.name: Adaptation
gimmick.description: Magnus drafts a perk before each boxing round. By the final round, he has a build. You're in an arms race.
